title: Multiprojective Geometry of Compatible Triples of Fundamental and Essential Matrices
summary: We characterize the variety of compatible fundamental matrix triples by computing its multidegree and multihomogeneous vanishing ideal. This answers the first interesting case of a question recently posed by Bråtelund and Rydell. Our result improves upon previously discovered sets of algebraic constraints in the geometric computer vision literature, which are all incomplete (as they do \emph{not} generate the vanishing ideal) and sometimes make restrictive assumptions about how a matrix triple should be scaled.
